description: This Java class, MongoQuery, implements the Query interface to represent MongoDB query parameters, including criteria, sort options, limit, and skip, with methods to access and convert these parameters for query execution.

classes.name: MongoQuery
classes.description: Immutable class representing a MongoDB query with criteria, sort options, limit, and skip parameters.

methods.name: MongoQuery
methods.description: Constructor initializing criteria, sort options, limit, and skip.

methods.name: getSortOptions
methods.description: Returns the list of sort options.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of documents to return.

methods.name: getSkip
methods.description: Returns the number of documents to skip.

methods.name: withCriteria
methods.description: Creates a new MongoQuery instance with updated criteria.

methods.name: getSortOptionsAsBson
methods.description: Converts sort options to a BSON object suitable for MongoDB queries.
